notes: Asking price and gross revenue are reliably present in the .listing-metrics section inside .listing-new-block, each in a .metric-box with a .metric-label and .metric-value. Cash flow is labeled 'Adjusted Net Income:' in the same metrics block on pages that show it; some listings show 'Asset Sale' instead with no value (not_disclosed=false since it appears on other pages). City and state are both embedded in the 'General Location:' list item inside the .info-list under the 'General Info:' section — they appear as a combined string (e.g. 'Nashville, TN' or 'Southeast United States') and must be parsed from that single field. The ct-inner-content section contains stale/template data from other listings and should be ignored; the authoritative data is in the .listing-new-block ct-code-block section.
